name: com.teleop.bridge
description: The only place Unity and Core meet: MonoBehaviour adapters that drive Teleop.Core, and Unity implementations of Core's interfaces. Shared by unity/TeleopVR (Quest, Unity 2022.3) and unity/TeleopXR (Galaxy XR, Unity 6.3) per docs/adr/0016, so it must compile under both editors. TextMeshPro is supplied by each project (com.unity.textmeshpro on 2022.3, com.unity.ugui 2.x on Unity 6).
